items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 2.6% in 1985 to 3.7% in 2025 across 47 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

3 of 47 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 1 for salt or chloride; 1 has a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 47 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 1 of 1 high-need ones have none.
